messages.subject: Urgent Help!!
parts:
Hi, I'm a newbie at this amazing thing called Wallace and I'm facing with some issues. The first one is that whenever I try to upload environmental layers that I've download from Chelsa, a error keeps popping: "Input rasters have unmatching NAs pixel values" and even tho I've read that this error wouldn't be a problem when I try to make my run, Wallace doesn't allow me to continue cause my layers never load. 
Another huge problem is that when I try to upload layers from Worldclim, at the moment that the layers are load, some occurrence points are deleted and this points in particular are importante to me cause they prove a particular feature of myu species. Can anyone help me with this problem, please?

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Urgent Help!!
parts:
You can try doing this in R: use the terra::mask() function with the is.na() function to find and replace NA values within your rasters.

In regard to the WorldClim data, occurrence records are removed if they are duplicates or when they fall within the same environmental grid cell. To include all points, increase grid cell resolution to 30 arcsec. If points are still removed, try Maxent outside of Wallace, which allows this option to be turned off, but caution that this may cause bias to these variables.
